name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution. Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v3.7.0 fingerprint freshness: registry refreshed against current-generation models — kimi-k3 registered (40 fresh samples via OpenCode Go, attribution-verified, zero-FP patterns); qwen3.8/deepseek-v4 sampled with fingerprints pending quality-pass (topic-pollution guard); registry freshness visible in pp_doctor. v3.7.0: discourse-structure heuristic layer (L12) — detects document-level social-media AI patterns (hook/reversal/slogan/engagement/parallelism/self-Q&A/closing/intensifiers) with density-scaled capped bump (cap 30); single-group hits recorded without scoring; fixes sentence-layer blind spot (LES-20260923-021); held-out AUROC unchanged 0.9022. Also: centralized FAQ (10 answers), script cheat sheet, clearer edge-case errors, scanner-surface hardening. v3.7.0: evaluation-driven docs upgrade — centralized FAQ section (9 answers), per-script cheat-sheet table, clearer style_distance edge-case errors. v3.6.0: academic-integrity guardrails (integrity_notice in every report, Academic Integrity section, positioning = author self-review & disclosure compliance, not detector evasion); English docs hardened to quality-framed wording per platform policy. v3.5.0: degraded-mode disclosure (engine mode + medical-register warning with held-out numbers), iron law #2 enforced (<100 chars -> risk=unknown), pp_doctor.py self-check, deai_gate usage guard, honest bilingual docs. v3.4.x: supervised layer + edit-regression v2 (human FPR@p99 0.71%, attack recall 86.6%), language gating, MD-separator fix. v3.0.0: eval-driven rebuild (AUROC 0.7046->0.9187 rules+spectrum held-out). v3.5.0 additions: UTF-8 stdout guard + GBK input tolerance on every entry (zh-CN default console crash fixed), deai_gate closed fallback loop (timeout caught; smell-layer failure -> neutral 50), docs honesty fixes (reproducibility scope, n=5,251 test half, bundled-regression 0.9022).
